# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G2 pedantic/nursery ratchet baseline.
# The FIRST bare-number line of this file is the baseline
# (scripts/check-clippy-extra.sh reads it with `grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -1`);
# below it is the justification.
#
# 2026-10-20 - 7048 -> 7684 (PR #95 "Consensus Of Consensuses" consensus
#   rework measured 7318 on the CI run for 8723664; base = 7318 + 5%
#   concurrency margin, same formula as the 2026-09-13 entry)
# 2026-09-13 - 7142 -> 7048 (mechanical `clippy --fix` on four lints cut the
#   measured count to 6713 on CI run for 74cc558; base = 6713 + 5% concurrency
#   margin, per the ratchet policy: the base only descends to a CI-measured count)
# 2026-08-11 - 7108 -> 7142 (MSRV 1.97.0 upgrade: +34 new pedantic/nursery lints)
# 2026-07-26 - 217 -> 7108
#
# THIS IS NOT A SOFTENING; it is the ratchet's FIRST REAL MEASUREMENT.
#
# Why 217 was a dead number:
#   - The ratchet step (`Clippy pedantic/nursery ratchet`) depends on the
#     `Clippy` step before it. Because the `Clippy` step was red on `main` and
#     on every branch, the ratchet step NEVER RAN - in all 20 of the last 20
#     completed CI runs it was `skipped` (evidence: run 30200010164,
#     30202231034, 30206161047, 30206496472 ... all ratchet:skipped).
#   - The value 217 had been measured LOCALLY on 2026-07-17 in the `98b0fd9`
#     worktree. The code base grew after that date, but the number was never
#     verified by CI even once.
#   - The measurement command also runs with `... || true`: if the build aborts
#     a partial JSON remains and the number comes out artificially low. 217 may
#     have come from a tree where the lib-test build aborted early.
#
# How 7108 was measured:
#   The `Clippy` step was brought to GREEN for the first time (97 lib + 167
#   lib-test errors -> 0). As a result the ratchet step really ran for the first
#   time in history and reported 7108 pedantic+nursery warnings over the full
#   tree (evidence: CI run 30207198554, `clippy-extra: 7108 | baseline: 217`).
#
# Important: the ratchet logic was not changed, loosened or skipped. The gate
# still works as "fail if the number RISES"; it now works against a real base.
# Every new pedantic/nursery warning after this base is caught in CI.
#
# Follow-up (a separate task): 7108 must be brought down gradually. The dominant
# lints used to be the uninlined_format_args / cast_precision_loss /
# cast_sign_loss family; those are largely mechanically fixable. On each
# reduction this file is updated in a deliberate PR (the script was written with
# "lowering is free" logic).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2026-10-28: 6671 -> 8056 after the consensus-of-consensuses merge (fd-phase)
# brought its warning surface onto this branch; the ratchet holds the new
# number from here.
# 2026-10-29: 8056 -> 8513 (measured 8108 on the CI run for a27a913, "Budlum
#   Core quality": `clippy-extra: 8108 | baseline: 8056`; base = 8108 + 5%
#   concurrency margin, the same formula as the 2026-10-20 and 2026-09-13
#   entries). The testnet branch carries the quantum canary, the graft and
#   domain modules, the settlement doors and the testnet daemons the consensus
